_readme: Content extracted verbatim from the prototype. ARCH order is also the tie-break order (first highest score wins). PERS[i] = [low line (answer < 3), high line (answer > 3)] for questions 1-4. SUITS[suit][rank] = card meaning (rank '1' = Ace). PHRASE overrides the lower-cased meaning when it is inserted mid-sentence. SUIT_POS[suit][k] = sentence for position k (0 Past, 1 Present, 2 Future). AURA[stage] = [x%, y%, scale] of the copper background glow; LAVPOS[stage] = [x%, y%] of the lavender glow.

questions.text: I tend to notice small changes in how people carry themselves when I'm talking to them.
I usually put some thought into how I present myself, even for casual outings.
When I'm excited about something, I tend to speak faster without realizing it.
I sometimes have to remind myself to adjust how loudly I'm speaking.
After spending a lot of time with others, I usually feel ready to keep socializing.
If a group is having trouble deciding something, I'm comfortable suggesting what we should do next.
When making a difficult choice, I tend to consider how it will affect others before focusing on the practical outcome.
I enjoy having a rough plan for my day, even if nothing important is scheduled.

archetypes.name: The Trailblazer
archetypes.description: Bold, adventurous, energetic, and willing to take risks.
archetypes.fortune: An unexpected opportunity is approaching. Your willingness to take the first step may lead you somewhere exciting.
archetypes.lens_present: You are the one who moves first.
archetypes.advice: Before you leap, name one person you will bring with you.

archetypes.name: The Dreamer
archetypes.fortune: Something you've been quietly hoping for may begin to take shape. Trust your creativity.
archetypes.lens_past: You felt this more than you showed.
archetypes.lens_present: It is living in your imagination right now.
archetypes.advice: Write the hope down this week, and give it one practical step.

archetypes.name: The Oracle
archetypes.fortune: A small detail others overlook may reveal an important answer. Pay attention to what isn't being said.
archetypes.lens_past: You noticed this before anyone said it out loud.
archetypes.lens_present: Watch the small signs around you now.
archetypes.advice: Say one thing out loud that you have only been observing.

archetypes.name: The Architect
archetypes.fortune: A plan you've been building is closer to taking shape than you realize. A small change could unlock progress.
archetypes.lens_present: It already fits into a plan you are making.
archetypes.advice: Leave one part of the plan unplanned.

archetypes.name: The Guardian
archetypes.fortune: A meaningful connection may grow stronger. Someone may appreciate your presence more than you know.
archetypes.lens_past: You carried this for someone else.
archetypes.lens_present: Someone close to you is part of it now.
archetypes.advice: Let someone look after you for once.

personal_lines.question: Q1
personal_lines.low: A new perspective may come from a detail you weren't looking for.
personal_lines.high: You notice what others miss. Watch for an opportunity hiding in plain sight.

personal_lines.question: Q2
personal_lines.low: Comfort suits you, and staying true to yourself will matter more than how it looks.
personal_lines.high: The way you present yourself is about to open a door. Wear your confidence.

personal_lines.question: Q3
personal_lines.low: Take your time. A thoughtful pause will say more than a quick answer.
personal_lines.high: Things may move quickly soon. Let your enthusiasm carry you.

personal_lines.question: Q4
personal_lines.low: Speak with intention and you will be heard, even quietly.
personal_lines.high: You are learning the size of your own voice, and soon someone will need to hear it.
